updates.name: David R. Foster

He was on the Harvard Organismic and Evolutionary Biology faculty from 1983 to 2022, directed the Harvard Forest from 1990 to 2020, and helped start its LTER program, serving as principal investigator 1994-2019. He co-developed the Wildlands and Woodlands conservation vision.

updates.name: David W. Bohnert
updates.bio: Director of Oregon State University's Eastern Oregon Agricultural Research Center, based at the Burns station. A ruminant nutritionist and OSU Extension beef cattle specialist, he studies nutrition strategies for sustainable beef production in the Intermountain West, grazing management, and how livestock use riparian, forest and sage-grouse habitats.

updates.name: David W. Clow
updates.bio: Research hydrologist formerly with the U.S. Geological Survey Colorado Water Science Center. His USGS work examined how snowpack change in high-elevation catchments couples water, carbon and nitrogen cycles, water quality at Hydrologic Benchmark Network stations, dust deposition on Rocky Mountain snow, and post-wildfire water quality.
updates.research_interests: snowpack and coupled water-carbon-nitrogen cycles in high-elevation catchments; Hydrologic Benchmark Network water-quality sampling; aeolian dust deposition to Rocky Mountain snowpacks; mountain pine beetle effects on forest hydrology; post-wildfire water quality

updates.name: David W. Inouye
updates.bio: Professor Emeritus of Biology at the University of Maryland. A pollination ecologist, he has spent summer field seasons at the Rocky Mountain Biological Laboratory from 1971 onward, where his NSF-funded long-term records of flowering phenology and plant demography inform climate-change effects at high elevation. He is a former ESA president.
updates.research_interests: pollination biology; flowering phenology; plant demography; plant-animal interactions (ant-plant mutualisms, nectar robbing, seed predation); bumblebees and hummingbirds; climate change effects on high-altitude plant communities
updates.current_affiliation: University of Maryland, Department of Biology
